title: The Tacit Dimension
author: Michael Polanyi
publisher: Doubleday & Company, Inc., Garden City, New York
context: Michael Polanyi, The Tacit Dimension (Doubleday, 1966, first edition): the 1962 Terry Lectures at Yale, three chapters of philosophical prose on tacit knowing, emergence and the society of science, with an Introduction, endnotes and a bibliography. American spelling and punctuation of the 1960s, occasionally British ('armoury'). Typography: running heads THE TACIT DIMENSION (left pages) and the chapter title (right pages) at the top, page numbers at the bottom; chapter openings start with a large initial capital followed by small capitals ('I HAVE GIVEN you'); footnotes are marked with an asterisk and set in smaller type at the foot of the page; the Notes section numbers its notes (1), (2), ... This copy is a library scan: it carries library stamps, a call number, and on some pages handwritten pencil marginalia. None of that is part of the book.
